name: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf

paragraphs.text: The Witcher: Nightmare of the Wolf is a 2021 adult animated dark fantasy film for Netflix, produced by Lauren Schmidt Hissrich, and starring Theo James, Lara Pulver, Graham McTavish, and Mary McDonnell. The film serves as a spin-off of the Netflix series The Witcher. It focuses on the origin story of Geralt's mentor and fellow witcher Vesemir. The film premiered on August 23, 2021.
Metacritic, which uses a weighted average, assigned the film a score of 67 out of 100, based on 5 critics, indicating "generally favorable" reviews.
The film was nominated for Best Animated Special Production at the 49th Annie Awards.
